exposure: non-cephalic presentation of the second twin
cohort: 581 women with live diamniotic twin pregnancies of at least 35 weeks of gestation who attempted trial of labor
finding: In twin pregnancies of at least 35 weeks gestation, nulliparity and non-cephalic presentation of the second twin were independent risk factors for intrapartum cesarean section, although most mothers with non-cephalic second twins achieved vaginal delivery with comparable perinatal outcomes to those with cephalic-presenting second twins.
mod_finding: The study found that nulliparity and non-cephalic presentation of the second twin were independent risk factors for intrapartum cesarean section in twin pregnancies.
